title: Critz: Treetop Trebuchet
description: Load a critter, wind a gravity-powered trebuchet, and earn Bells for upgrades.
controls: Drag the critter into the sling, hold the clearing or launcher button to wind, then release. Keyboard: Enter loads; hold and release Space to launch. Pause opens options.

title: Critz: Tycoon
description: Explore Rootport and care for a small living world. Existing story and ecosystem prototype.
controls: Use the on-screen movement and action controls, or WASD / arrow keys to move. Follow the game’s dialogue and action prompts.

title: Critz: Baa’d Math
description: Keep count as unusual sheep cross the sky. Try not to wake the wolf.
controls: Tap the left half to subtract and right half to add. A/D or arrow keys also work. Hold to repeat. Space or Escape pauses. Multiplication buttons unlock during play.

title: Critz Tower Defense
description: The Buttonwood / Tower of Babel prototype: mine, craft, build and defend a growing tower.
controls: Use the game’s toolbar to select tools and structures, then click or tap the world. Drag to pan; use the on-screen camera controls. Open the in-game help for advanced controls.

title: Critz Kingdom Conquest
description: Command a Conqueror alongside eighteen animated animal minions in the existing single-player battlefield prototype.
controls: Right-click to move or attack. Q/W/E/R cast toward the cursor; Space centers the camera; A then click performs attack-move; S stops; B recalls; F flashes. Scroll zooms. Mouse and keyboard are required for movement; touch can use menus and ability buttons.

title: Ctrl Alt Del — Episode I
description: An existing campaign prototype with combat, scenes and editable levels. Supporting art and dialogue remain provisional.
controls: A/D or arrows move; W/up jumps; S/down crouches; Space fires; F strikes; E interacts; Q throws; C uses watch; Escape pauses. Enter continues dialogue, Tab skips a scene. Keyboard required.

title: Serpent Siege
description: The current Snake Game Test: evade the serpent’s head and sever its tail for points.
controls: WASD or arrows move; Shift sprints; Space slashes; P pauses. Enter a local name and choose Start. Keyboard required.

title: Critz: Battlefront Minimalist
description: An early team-battle shooter slice with simple geometric graphics.
controls: Click to start and capture the mouse. WASD moves; mouse aims; click fires; Space jumps. Escape releases the mouse. Desktop mouse and keyboard required.

title: Critz Runner
description: Jump and duck through this small existing runner experiment. Scores stay on this device.
controls: Space or up jumps; down ducks; P pauses; R restarts. On touch screens, use the arcade buttons below the game.

title: Katana Mouse
description: Move, slash and survive in the existing arena minigame.
controls: WASD or arrows move; Space slashes; Shift dashes; F uses a special attack; Q uses the arcane gun when unlocked; R restarts. Keyboard required.

title: Critter Quest
description: Choose a critter hero and explore an existing choice-based adventure.
controls: Choose a hero, then click or tap the actions and choices.

title: Critz Card Game
description: Play the existing critter card and board prototype.
controls: Use the on-screen cards, board spaces and action buttons. Click or tap the available choices; the game shows turn and resource information.
